title: MIKI-AI0.2 File Relation Ledger — P293 CORE autonomy corrections
sourceSnapshot: P290 ZIP-derived source snapshot updated locally for P293 CORE autonomy corrections. P290 service authority convergence is retained; 1,787 baseline paths refreshed for current hashes, line counts and static import graph. GitHub main not updated.

githubMainObservationAtP280Audit.commitMessage: fix: align canonical revision verifier with P275
githubMainObservationAtP280Audit.snapshotSynchronization: DIVERGED: this P279 ZIP snapshot and public GitHub main are not the same tree; this ledger is scoped to the ZIP snapshot and is not evidence of a main update.

selectionPolicy: Retain the unified F001-F1787 repository-path inventory from P290, excluding generated cache artifacts and new audit scripts from the fixed baseline. Refresh hashes, line counts, module edges, importers and reachability for all baseline records. P290 service authority convergence remains separately recorded; P292 adds CORE runtime regression fixes; P293 adds worker state guards, dependency failure propagation, lease validation and evidence-store quarantine.

methodology.graph: Current static module import/export/re-export/side-effect/dynamic-import graph. P290 replaces outgoing edges from each legacy service path with one re-export edge to its canonical src/miki domain module; callers through existing legacy paths remain in the graph. This is static module evidence, not runtime function invocation.
methodology.runtimeCaveat: P293 retains one canonical implementation/singleton per each of the 37 audited service pairs and retired LoRA execution. P293 CORE autonomy regression checks cover completion package requirements, explicit-search re-entry, explicit error recovery lineage, and validated conversation finalization. Full typecheck/build/device verification is not implied.
methodology.purpose: Track path-level code roles, current static dependencies/importers, classifications and proven authority consolidations. Similar filenames are not treated as duplicates without source and contract review.
methodology.heuristicFields: detectedKeyLikeStringLiterals and detectedEventTokenCandidates are lexical candidates, not authoritative storage/event registries.
methodology.duplicatePolicy: same basename is a review flag, not proof of duplicate responsibility. Content hash and import reachability are recorded independently.
methodology.capabilityClassification: Added independent capabilityCategory, architectureDomain, artifactKind, implementationRole, classificationConfidence, classificationEvidence, authorityCandidatePath, and authorityRelationship fields. Path is the primary evidence; low-confidence/unscoped sources remain explicit review items. Non-domain technical/artifact categories are not counted as extra MIKI capability domains.
methodology.duplicateAudit: Computed exact byte SHA-256 groups across all 1789 baseline records, comment/whitespace-normalized source hash candidates, same-basename groups, and src/miki versus src/services same-basename pairs. Similarity scores are triage heuristics, not proof of semantic equivalence. Pure re-export facades are separated from full implementation candidates. P287 adds an ordered P1 review queue for high-similarity cross-layer pairs where both paths are statically reachable from CORE/UI and adds interpretation notes to prevent overlapping findings from being summed.
methodology.authoritySelection: The src/miki domain path is listed as a likely authority candidate only when duplicate implementation similarity supports a review candidate; static importers and CORE/UI reachability are provided. No runtime implementation was removed, merged, or automatically declared equivalent.
methodology.functionalCapabilityClassification: Each record gets primaryFunctionalCapability, functionalCapabilityTags, confidence, and evidence from weighted matches in path, prior purpose description, and exported symbols. This is triage metadata, not a semantic/runtime proof.
methodology.authorityReviewP288: All 37 P287 P1 cross-layer pairs were re-opened in the P287 source snapshot. For each side, direct static importer paths/lines and export identifier references were collected; public contract signatures, direct dependency specifiers, persistent string-key constants, singleton/state/side-effect markers, and source-body diff hunks after excluding import statements were compared. Architecture-layer path is a recommended authority candidate, not a proof of runtime ownership. Behaviorally divergent pairs are explicitly assigned migration constraints. No runtime files were deleted, merged, or redirected.
methodology.loRARetirementP289: Source-level removal includes MemoryModal export/preview UI, virtualTrainingService, LoRA type aliases, native adapter APIs, active feature flag, storage partitions and experience-router path/export. The one-time migration of old persisted identifiers is retained to avoid data loss/re-enabling retired configuration.
methodology.authorityConvergenceP290: P290 reviewed all 37 former src/miki/<domain>/services vs src/services parallel implementation pairs. The Miki domain implementation is canonical; legacy path forwards exports only. Divergent behavior is preserved on canonical implementations after contract and caller checks.

sourceFacts.firstDocCommentExcerpt: 端末内 合成教材生成パイプライン (設計思想 33節・53節 フェーズ7) 【設計方針 (文書33節準拠)】: 1. Qwen自身に問題・模範解答・採点を全部やらせたデータは正式教材にしない。 2. 「機械的に正誤判定できる」問題のみを対象とし、模範正解は通常プログラム（確定アルゴリズム）から作成する。 3. 弱点分野（成功率の低い能力、再発の多いカテゴリ）に偏らせて生成する。 4. データ状態管理: GENERATED → VERIFIED → CANDIDATE → APPROVED / REJECTED 5. 信頼度は機械検証済みのため source: 'synthetic' / reliability: 'high' で登録。

sourceFacts.firstDocCommentExcerpt: 設計思想 63章 & 64章: VBA静的検証器 (VBA Static Verifier) 8大スキャナー構成 【63章 生成ルール】: 1. 修正対象プロシージャは全文生成する (省略・差分パッチ禁止) 2. Goto と行ラベルを禁止する 3. If はブロックIfとする (単行If禁止) 4. 既存Public署名を維持する 5. 既存分岐と例外処理を無断削除しない 【64章 8大構成要素】: 1. Parser: コメント・文字列・継続行を考慮して構造を解析する 2. ProcedureScanner: Sub・Function・Propertyの開始・終了を取得する 3. BlockScanner: If・For・Do・Select・Withなどのネストを確認する 4. ForbiddenPatternScanner: Goto・行ラベル・単行If・省略記号を検出する 5. DeclarationScanner: O

mergedBehaviorPreservation.canonicalBehavior: Uses the Miki deterministicRuntimeService embedding contract; legacy copy used nonLlmRuntimeService for the same deterministic feature embedding algorithm. Legacy storage/search API is retained through facade.
Keeps canonical evaluation flow; legacy difference was a syntax/local-binding rewrite with equivalent iteration semantics.
Preserves deterministic capability candidate graduation and legacy skill-record migration; no dataset/LoRA route is retained.
Canonical plan API supports exclusion list, environment and allowed component kinds, covering the legacy exclusion/environment parameters.
Keeps semantic dictionary graph lookup, source-priority merge and duplicate suppression.
Keeps verified_candidate routing and routeToCapabilityCandidate; no legacy LoRA destination/export is reintroduced.
Uses the canonical retired-flag policy; persisted old LORA_TRAINING values are only removed during migration.
Keeps counterfactual measurement/review fields and validation, as a superset of the legacy runner contract.
Keeps CapabilityLearningCandidate -> deterministic capability patch flow. Legacy TrainingSampleJSONL duplicate implementation is removed; existing active callers use candidate/evidence APIs.
Keeps question-intent and deterministic fallback; explicit empty-input guard now matches the legacy normalization contract.
Keeps source/evidence metadata and promotion, unknown-task decomposition and experience-link integration; optional fields remain backward compatible.

compatibilityNotes: All exported names for the 37 audited pairs were checked to be named exports; each facade uses export * to preserve those exports.
Callers using old src/services paths continue to resolve, but now receive the canonical singleton instead of a second independent module instance.
Old trainingSampleId/graduatedToTrainingAt field strings remain only in skill-data migration logic; this is not an active training route.
The Japanese morphology template/app copy and required Android resource path pairs were not deleted: separate paths are required by installer/platform resource lookup.
